what: Every round-five finding mapped to the canonical task(s) it bears on, with a classification.
why: A finding that maps to no task disappears. This phase lost nine canonical tasks by counting a table plus an unlisted remainder; the same arithmetic applied to findings would lose findings. `tests/ci/p1-27-finding-map.test.ts` requires the map to cover every id in `adversarial-round-five.md` exactly once, and every task id to exist in `task-matrix.json`.

buckets.FOUNDATION: Cross-cutting: bears on no single canonical task. Must carry an owningConcern, and cannot be used to make a task-specific finding disappear.
buckets.note: A finding may name both real task ids and FOUNDATION only when it genuinely does both; the test refuses FOUNDATION as a lone escape hatch for anything classified REAL_P1_27_DEFECT.
